title: Rafael and the Extraction
author: Tamsin Montrose
blurb: Yara Almeida, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
